posts.title: TinyRec 0.1.5: camera segments on the timeline, region recording fixes, and a guides site
posts.description: Hide or push the camera fullscreen at any moment in your timeline, region recording exports without black bars, the trim-from-left bug is gone, and there's a full /guides site now.

posts.title: TinyRec 0.1.4: record your iPhone, frame it like a phone, and a sharper editor
posts.description: Plug an iPhone in over USB and capture its screen at native resolution, wrap the recording in a real device bezel, and a pile of editor polish on top.
